What is the Tirumala package cost?

Tirumala trip costs are confirmed individually for your travel date, pickup point, number of travellers, vehicle and hotel preference. Tell the owner what you need on WhatsApp to receive a quote. Darshan ticket guidance does not include booking tickets or guaranteeing official availability.

Family travel and vehicle planning

Tell the owner about older travellers, children, walking needs, rest breaks and luggage. Choose a car, SUV or larger group vehicle as a preference; seating and availability are confirmed directly.

Hotel preferences are Deluxe (Budget), Exclusive and Premium. Ask the owner to confirm the property and arrangements for your dates.

We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.

Check current darshan information with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD). Use TTD’s official online services to check ticket availability and book directly. We provide guidance only.

Talk to the ownerCall +91 97001 81493

What should I confirm for my family?

  • Adults, children and older travellers, plus luggage and any walking or rest needs.
  • Your darshan date and reporting time, arrival time, pickup point and return journey.
  • The confirmed car model, passenger seats and luggage space.
  • Whether a hotel is needed, the number of rooms and nights, bed needs and meal arrangements.

AC cars, SUVs and larger group vehicles can be requested. A vehicle category or hotel preference is a request; the owner confirms the actual arrangements.
